description: A grid of lights and note names showing where on the lattice of whole-number frequency ratios LameJuis is currently playing
notes: it has no jacks and no controls; place it immediately to the right of LameJuis, the only module it reads, and it goes dark beside anything else
the horizontal axis counts the Top interval and the vertical axis the Middle interval; the Bottom interval moves between planes of the lattice
only one plane is drawn at a time, the one holding the most voices, and the lowest wins a tie, so a voice on another plane shows nothing
voice 1 lights red, voice 2 green and voice 3 blue, and a polyphonic voice lights one square per channel
the squares are named as notes while all three intervals are the familiar ones and no interval CV is patched; otherwise they are labelled in cents
